name: thumbnail-slider
title: Thumbnail Slider
description: A photo viewer with one large rounded frame on top and a row of small previews beneath. Picking a thumbnail swaps the main picture and lights that thumbnail.
use: A gallery has several photos and users want to jump to one quickly.
avoid: Seven remote photos load at once, so blank slides appear on a slow connection.
a11y: Thumbnails are clickable divs, not buttons, and every main photo's alt text is just "image". (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded photo slide above a row of seven small square thumbnails; the current thumbnail has a light border and the others are dimmed. The loaded main image is a lake scene with rocks and autumn trees.
behaves: Clicking a thumbnail jumps the large photo to that slide and moves the highlight; the strips stay in sync as they slide.
customise: Seven image URLs are hardcoded; slide height and thumbnail size are classes in the file.
weight: moderate: Seven full-size photos plus thumbnails load together; scrolling is light.
